8 files: 8 test suites holding 53 `[test]` functions, 0 compile-fail fixtures, 0 scripts. How a test tree is laid out and what each class of file is: `tests/ARCHITECTURE.md` at the repo root.

## integration/

### test_compute.das

- `test_compute` - a compute shader run through the boost helpers squares all 256 elements
- `test_batch_creators` - batch-created descriptor sets, command buffers and compute pipelines are all used by a real dispatch
- `test_compute_shared` - workgroup shared memory, a barrier and an atomicAdd sum the lane ids to 2016 and one lane writes the mark 64
- `test_subgroup_pin_gpu` - a compute pipeline pinned to a required subgroup width runs at exactly that width
- `test_subgroup_gpu` - subgroup arithmetic, ballot and shuffle give the lane-derived answer on every invocation
- `test_spec_constants_gpu` - specialization constants override the scale and the workgroup size while the defaults hold without them
- `test_storage_8_16_gpu` - q8_0 blocks read through 8 and 16 bit SSBO storage dequantize to the host-computed values
- `test_storage_8_16_store_gpu` - int8 and int16 element stores from adjacent invocations land exact bytes in the SSBO
- `test_coopmat_gpu` - a 16x16 cooperative-matrix multiply-accumulate equals the exact CPU product
- `test_coopmat_f16_acc_rounding_gpu` - an f16 cooperative-matrix accumulator rounds between a sequential f16 sum and one rounding of the exact sum
- `test_coopmat2_scale_acc_gpu` - the NV cooperative-matrix2 per-index scale and accumulate equals the exact CPU sum
- `test_integer_dot_gpu` - sdot4 on packed int8 words gives the same result on the GPU as its CPU body

### test_descriptor_heap.das

- `test_descriptor_heap_square` - the descriptor-heap example squares every element through a resource heap, skipping where the extension is absent
- `test_resource_heap_layout` - the resource heap layout aligns descriptors behind the reserved range and refuses sizes past the limit

### test_descriptors.das

- `test_bindless_descriptor_array_red` - index 0 into a sampler2D descriptor array samples the red texture
- `test_bindless_descriptor_array_green` - index 1 into a sampler2D descriptor array samples the green texture
- `test_bindless_descriptor_array_blue` - index 2 into a sampler2D descriptor array samples the blue texture
- `test_bindless_descriptor_array_yellow` - index 3 into a sampler2D descriptor array samples the yellow texture
- `test_nonuniform_ext_red` - a nonuniform-indexed descriptor array samples the red texture at index 0
- `test_nonuniform_ext_blue` - a nonuniform-indexed descriptor array samples the blue texture at index 2
- `test_boost_descriptors` - the boost descriptor path keeps descriptorCount 1 so the shader sees the storage buffer and squares every element

### test_device.das

- `test_enumerate` - the instance enumerates a physical device with a graphics queue family, memory, and a consistent cooperative-matrix2 ladder
- `test_memory_types` - try_find_memory_type answers -1 for an empty mask and find_memory_type agrees with it for a fitting type
- `test_os_video_memory` - the OS video-memory query keeps usage within budget and reads zeros for a device with no LUID
- `test_debug_messenger` - a debug-utils messenger is created with the default vk_debug_callback and destroyed
- `test_handles` - an owning image handle finalizes once while its weak_copy stays non-owning
- `test_stype_prefill` - the sType-prefilling constructors carry the right sType and the driver fills real data
- `test_opt_ptr_view_semantics` - a vk view consumes the opt-ptr field so a second view of the same struct sees it as absent
- `test_device_table_reloads` - each new device loads the function table once, a second load for a live device is a no-op, and a device made after another was destroyed loads again even at the same handle value

### test_rendering.das

- `test_rt_smoke` - a BLAS, a TLAS and one ray-tracing pipeline trace into a storage image with left-half rays missing and right-half rays hitting
- `test_triangle` - the fixture triangle renders red, blue and green corners with a blended centroid
- `test_phase4_textured_quad` - a reflection-built textured quad samples the four texels in the right quadrants with the push-constant tint applied
- `test_dynamic_rendering_gate` - dynamic rendering support follows the instance and device version and require_dynamic_rendering panics only without the pair
- `test_rendering_formats_chain` - rendering_formats heads the pNext chain, keeps what the chain held and names no color format for a depth-only pipeline
- `test_gl_draw_id_indirect` - gl_DrawID selects a distinct color for each of four indirect draws
- `test_gltf_box` - Box.glb renders through the rigid PBR path as a lit red box over the clear color
- `test_gltf_simple_skin` - SimpleSkin.gltf renders through the skinned path with a lit center that differs from the clear color

### test_shader_objects.das

- `test_shader_objects_triangle` - two linked shader objects bound per stage render the red, green and blue triangle corners

### test_textures.das

- `test_sampler2darray` - a sampler2DArray fragment selects the right layer, so the four quadrant colors equal the four layer colors
- `test_separate_image_sampler` - a separate texture2D and sampler combine into the four texel colors, one per quadrant
- `test_storage_image_gradient` - a compute shader writes a coordinate gradient into a storage image and every pixel reads back exact
- `test_texelfetch_copy` - texelFetch copies a 64x64 source texture into a storage image with every texel exact
- `test_texture_grad_mips` - textureGrad with explicit dx and dy selects the expected mip level in each band

### test_ubo_layouts.das

- `test_ubo_mat3_shared_walk` - a UBO with a mat3, an array and a vec4 is read at the std140 offsets the shared walk wrote
- `test_ubo_multi_first_block` - with two uniform blocks the generated bind writes the first block while the host upload serves the second
- `test_ubo_nested_palette_red` - palette index 0 in a nested-struct UBO selects red through the access chains
- `test_ubo_nested_palette_green` - palette index 1 in a nested-struct UBO selects green through the access chains
- `test_ubo_nested_palette_blue` - palette index 2 in a nested-struct UBO selects blue through the access chains
- `test_push_std140` - a push-constant block holding a mat3 and a scalar after a vec3 is read at the std140 offsets
- `test_reflect_mappers` - the reflection descriptor kinds and stage flags map to the matching Vulkan enums
- `test_reflect_merge_shared_binding` - one binding declared by two stages merges into a single binding carrying both stage flags
- `test_reflect_merge_distinct_bindings` - two different bindings in one set stay separate and keep their insertion order
- `test_pipeline_boost_structs` - a graphics pipeline built only from boost view structs renders exact pixels for both batch entries
